note: apex300-compat-1110 (2026-11-10, docs/254 §6): Apex Radiance 3.0.0 + pair rc1111 compatibility, a HARD release gate (Rodney 11-10). Runs right after release-verify-1111 ends (~14:30 PHT), before the night timing run. WITH arm only: copy game-copy/apex-3.0.0/ApexRadiance.asi (sha256 bf47aa32, 12572672 bytes) into Bin by hand before the queue and remove it after (queue.ts has no Apex support); leave Apex's ApexRadiance.toml as the test install has it (record whether MemoryGuard is on: it decides the [SaveWrite] 0xAB12AF stand-down line). S3SS and S3PP stay in Bin as in release-verify-1111. Ours-alone control = release-verify-1111 rows (same pair, same saves). Apex-alone or with/alone arms only on a FAIL, via tools/harness/apex-run.ts, after logging (AGENTS.md crash rule; --arms with,alone needs Rodney's 'ok bisect'). Edit Town household switch is not here: its repro start-edittown-switch-family is not in repros.json yet (lane apex300-edittown-*-1110); run that queue with the rc1111 pair once it lands. 6 correctness jobs, est ~152 min. After the queue read in each ts3native.log copy: 'crash log: N more AVs at logged addresses in other modules' (Apex first-chance AV rate, docs/254 R1/R2). node tools/harness/queue.ts tools/harness/queues/apex300-compat-1110.json --no-smoke
